turns.patient_response: I’ve been really strict about cutting back on what I eat to stay as light and quick as possible for the job, and it’s gotten out of hand. I work as a firefighter, and what started as a way to improve my performance has just gone too far.

turns.patient_response: The department doctor noted my weight is significantly low, but seeing the scale drop makes me feel like I'm doing something right. turns.patient_response: When I look in the mirror, I don't see myself as underweight at all; I just focus on any spot that doesn't look completely lean or "cut." Even though the department doctor says my weight is way too low, looking at my reflection makes me feel like I still have room to lean out. If I'm not the leanest guy on my crew, I feel like I'm failing at being the strong, dependable firefighter I'm supposed to be.
